department: Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences
school: Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences

requirements.name: Freshman Seminar
requirements.note: Transfer students take BIO SCI 190 instead of BIO SCI 2A.
requirements.note_zh: 转学生改修 BIO SCI 190 替代 BIO SCI 2A。

requirements.name: Biological Sciences Core (lower-division)
requirements.note: BIO SCI 93/94/97 also offered as honors versions H93/H94/H97.
requirements.note_zh: BIO SCI 93/94/97 另有荣誉版 H93/H94/H97。

requirements.name: Calculus
requirements.note: Either MATH 5A-5B (Calculus for Life Sciences) or MATH 2A-2B; engine defaults to 5A-5B on a cost tie.
requirements.note_zh: MATH 5A-5B（生命科学微积分）或 MATH 2A-2B 二选一；同分时引擎默认取 5A-5B。

requirements.name: Statistics / Mathematics Elective
requirements.note: School table lists STATS 7, STATS 8, MATH 2D, MATH 3A as parallel rows; modeled as select 1 (engine defaults to STATS 7 on a cost tie).
requirements.name_zh: 低年级数学/统计（四选一）
requirements.note_zh: 学院表将 STATS 7、STATS 8、MATH 2D、MATH 3A 列为并列行，按选一建模；同分时引擎默认取 STATS 7。

requirements.name: Physics
requirements.note: Students double-majoring in Chemistry take PHYSICS 7C-7D-7E + 7LC-7LD instead (not modeled; 7-series is cheaper in units so it cannot stay an engine option).
requirements.note_zh: 化学双专业方向改修 PHYSICS 7C-7D-7E + 7LC-7LD（未建模：7 系列总学分更低，不能留在引擎选项里，否则会被误选）。

requirements.name: A. Required Major Courses (select 3)
requirements.name_zh: A. 专业核心课（选 3 门）

requirements.name: B. Upper-Division Laboratories (select 2)
requirements.note: One lab may be satisfied by Excellence in Research in Biological Sciences
requirements.name_zh: B. 高年级实验课（选 2 门）
requirements.note_zh: 其中一门实验课可用「生物科学卓越研究」（Excellence in Research in Biological Sciences）替代

requirements.name: C. Upper-Division Biology Electives (select 4 four-unit courses)
requirements.note: From BIO SCI D103-D190, E106-E190, M114-M190, N110-N190 ranges plus listed CHEM/PHRMSCI
requirements.name_zh: C. 高年级生物选修（选 4 门 4 学分的课）
requirements.note_zh: 范围：BIO SCI D103-D190、E106-E190、M114-M190、N110-N190，以及列出的 CHEM/PHRMSCI 课程

notes: A/B/C from the Biological Sciences B.S. program page; lower-division core from the Charlie Dunlop School of Biological Sciences school requirements table (https://catalogue.uci.edu/charliedunlopschoolofbiologicalsciences/#schoolrequirementstext). Honors variants (H93/H94/H97, CHEM H2/H52 series) and the PHYSICS 7-series alternative are documented in notes only, not modeled as engine options.
